verdict.rationale: LiveKit's own tooling can create tokens and access server APIs, the server supports JWT authentication, and the docs point to connecting web or mobile apps. One community user calls it the best WebRTC getting-started experience. However, the pack never shows the end-to-end flow the story describes. missing for 10: documented server-side room/session creation API, permission-scoped join token minting via server SDK, official client SDK connect steps, a short end-to-end quickstart tying these together.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a session from my server, mint a scoped join token, and connect a client with the official SDK in a short documented flow

citations.quote: server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents.
Built for production, supports JWT authentication
Bring your agent to life through a web or mobile app.
Looks like the best WebRTC get going experience I've seen.
